raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Delivery batch 14 (ingested 2026-01-19) sends amount as a currency-formatted string with a leading '$' (e.g. '$14.09'), so the strict DECIMAL cast in silver_transactions fails. All rows are currency USD, and the values match the magnitude of earlier batches, so the '$' is only formatting.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(replace(replace(trim(CAST(amount AS VARCHAR)), '$', ''), ',', '') AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
